image_description: A group of young girls in matching light blue dresses dancing around a maypole outdoors. The maypole is a tall vertical structure with long, colorful ribbons (red, green, yellow, blue) extending from the top down to the dancers' hands. The background shows spectators and a building facade. The scene appears to be a May Day celebration or similar festival.
